subject: 241.travel
tagline: A last-minute hotel club with free nights, an AI concierge, and a public rule that a person decides wherever money or data are involved.

what_it_does.text: 241.travel (T.B.G Ellmau OG, Tyrol) is a members-only last-minute hotel club in Europe: every deal includes at least one free night, from 1+1 to 6+1, with arrival from today to 20 days ahead and no prepayment. Hotels pay 8.88% commission only after the guest arrives; 510 partner hotels. Its concierge Rio answers members' messages using Anthropic or Google Gemini, with voice by ElevenLabs.

agents.name: Rio (241 concierge)
agents.what: An AI concierge that answers members' messages and drafts replies.

agents.name: Back-office agents
agents.what: "Agentic systems for backoffice", in the Web Summit pitch; not described on the site.
actions: Not described on the company's own pages

use_cases.name: A member asks Rio for a 1+1 weekend

reach.what: Model providers: Anthropic or Google Gemini (inputs not used for training, per the site); voice by ElevenLabs

mandate.what: Illustrative: answer and draft; a person sends and decides on bookings, money and data.

gap.what: The Web Summit pitch speaks of agentic back-office systems; the site's AI statement says people send and decide. Which is current is not stated.
